caption: The drawing depicts a single stoneware vessel centered on a plain, light tan background. The vessel has a wide, round body with a narrow, slightly flared neck and thick rim. Two handles are present on opposite sides near the top, each rendered with blue highlighting. Blue decorative lines and swirls are painted on the surface, including a stylized fish on the upper part and curvilinear patterns below it. At the bottom, a small, square element with a circular center is shown, possibly representing a spigot or drain. The body of the vessel is gray with subtle shading, while the rim interior is depicted in brown. The blue designs and handle accents contrast with the otherwise neutral tones of the vessel and background.
title: Cask
